description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods—Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS—on a task evaluated by “Average Performance,” with values ranging from 0 to 60 on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the methods in order from left to right: Self-RAG (orange bar, ~55), FactTune (light green bar, ~58), CInGS (w/) (blue bar, ~60), and CInGS (dark blue bar, ~65). The bars are arranged in ascending order of performance, with CInGS achieving the highest score, followed by CInGS (w/), FactTune, and Self-RAG. The chart uses distinct colors for each method and includes a grid with horizontal dashed lines at intervals of 10 to aid in value estimation. The y-axis is labeled “Average Performance” and appears to be on a linear scale. The chart is tilted slightly clockwise, giving it a 3D perspective effect, though no depth axis is present. The title or context “Paper: Context-Informed Grounding Supervision” suggests this chart is from a research paper evaluating grounding supervision methods, with CInGS demonstrating superior performance over the baselines.
